'''Kanzhei Opli''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] over [[719 BBY/Legends|seven hundred years]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Kanzhei Opli was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and training independently as a [[Jedi Beast Master]]. Serving the Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for decades, Opli was responsible for creating the [[Tuk'ata Nobilis|nobilis]] subspecies of the fierce [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] beasts. Gifting the two nobilis creatures to the people of [[Vaklin]] for their devotion to the Order and support of its members, the Vaklin people kept the beasts inside the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]] there to safeguard its halls. Considered to be one of the finest Beast Masters of the Order by the adherents on Vaklin, the nobilis creatures were slain by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] asserted its control over the world.<ref name="TTF2" />
